arguments.title: Migration history: post-audit rollback-path fix (May 2023)
arguments.body: On May 30, 2023, the shard-keeper rollback-path follow-up from the May 22 audit was completed. The previous rollback procedure required three coordinated commands and could leave the service partially reverted if timing was unfavorable. The fix made rollback a one-command operation. It passed four staging runs consecutively with clean results. This closed the audit-side rollback follow-up and removed the blocker to restarting the shard-keeper migration. Record this as a completed historical change; the evidence here is staging validation, not a claim of a production rollback.
